name: survivor-census
description: The survivor census: who the many-worlds sorter actually keeps. The visitor's sentence — 'postselection lets the optimal branch stay, complexity O(1); the cost is the depreciation of the other universes, and I booked it' — had its restart accounting (postselect-sched T2), its counting power (T3/T5) and its scheduling surface (T4), all on the UNIFORM prior. The survivor himself was never audited: this repo executes the semantics. The survivor is the posterior over optima weighted by the prior you brought (integer-ratio referee vs amplitude path, coherence phases kept, purity 1 with a mixed address reading); the kill register is itemized per universe and sums to 1-P exactly on two paths; the waiting price is the exact geometric schedule (1-P)^k <= delta with the minimality check, against the conservative exp bound; and the boundaries are executable — P=0 (no funded optimum) refuses to print, a marked branch with zero prior weight never comes back, P=1 sorts nothing. A closing table reconciles the letter's two epoch-3 rates as one wall: 'O(1)' and 'hit rate 100%' are both conditional-frame truths whose unconditional yields (P per trial; net(p)) are the price columns. v0.2.0 adds two faces: sequential postselection — stacked ledgers compose by the chain rule P_AB = P_A*P_2, never additively; the posterior-of-posterior telescopes to the posterior over the composed funded set (fraction and sequential-projection paths); staged kill registers are disjoint items summing to 1-P_AB; the waiting price renews as 1/P_A + (1-P_2)/(P_A P_2); amortized kill-odds ADD; a starved intersection refuses (P=0 inherited through the chain) — with a C1-C5 audit that names and rejects counterfeit composition claims; and the phase-encoding census — the ledger is phase-blind (P, register, E[T] invariant across flat/sign/Fourier/random encodings, deviation exactly 0) while the state is phase-carrying (self-overlap 1; |overlap| = 1 exactly for constant phase differences on the funded set, strictly below 1 on every non-constant family censused). The checker enforces the census laws — a single-face rate, an unwitnessed EXACT, a dead anchor, an illegal label, or a duplicate id all fail the build. v0.3.0 is a code-quality wave with frozen mathematics (rendered report byte-identical): every kernel refusal carries a named CensusError code — the composition refusal chain discriminates by code, not message text; an out-of-range stage-B mark, a non-finite phase and mcWaiting's zero-run NaN are named rejections instead of silently accepted inputs — structurally-guaranteed lookups refuse by name (expectFound) instead of leaking undefined, and the 1e-12 two-path tolerance is single-sourced in kernel/tol.ts.
